questions.markdown:
Sketch the following signals

a. $x(t) = u(t) - u(t - 2)$

b. $y(t) = u(t + 1) - 2u(t) + u(t - 1)$

Determine whether the following systems are LTI systems or not,

a) $y(t) = at^{2}x(t) + bt\,x(t - 4)$

b) $y[n] = a^{n}x(n)$

Determine if the following system is causal and memoryless

$y(t) = x(2 - t) + x(t - 4)$

Obtain the block diagram representations for systems described by the following difference equations:

a) 

$$
y(t) = -\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)\frac{dy(t)}{dt} + 4x(t)
$$

b) 

$$
\frac{dy(t)}{dt} + 3y(t) = x(t)
$$
What are the sufficient conditions for the existence of the Fourier series of a periodic function $x(t)$?

Obtain the Fourier transform of the signal

$$
x(t) = e^{-2t}\cos(5t)\,u(t)
$$
